summary: [spec fidelity] Task ids are escaped too: `s1-state-model-join-spine#6.2` is stored as `…+236.2` and the sqlite id of task `add-login#1` becomes `add-login+231` (ledger_naming_01, ledger_migrate_10). layout.rs's module doc says a task id's `#` is escaped, but the accepted design's R6 names only free-text components (session id, regime key segment, handoff id) and says typed kebab/dot ids never need it. The behaviour is consistent with R6's mechanism and round-trips; the design doc should say every typed or free-text component is escaped and give the task-id example, so readers of names and object keys are not surprised.
